title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: The Tigers sending out a glowing update on their cheap as hell ticket sale, bending over backwards for any publicity might be close to a rock bottom
I’m not writing about it - I know the situation you guys are in - but this email this AM was cringe-worthy

That’s Granger-Baldwin kinda stuff. It would never have happened 2 years ago. They love the gimmick stuff especially when it’s online related. If it goes well, you’ll get another press release or leak about how good it was.
